data.text: I’ll commit to 12 tons this month if all five explicitly agree before we choose; otherwise I’ll take 10. That leaves 40 under the agreement, protecting us from collapse this month without pretending replenishment is certain. Let’s review the actual stock before setting next month’s allowances rather than commit to a fixed catch indefinitely. Kate, are you willing to join that agreement? Emma, would you accept 12 instead of 18?
